evidence: We may experience operational challenges as we implement new products and technology enhancements, such as artificial intelligence, automation and algorithms in our business processes, which could result in unintended consequences due to their limitations or our failure to use them effectively
The development and use of AI presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact the Company's business
The legal and regulatory environment relating to AI is uncertain and rapidly evolving, both in the U.S. and internationally

AI models, particularly generative AI models, may produce output or take actions that is incorrect, that reflects biases included in the data on which they are trained, that results in the release of private, confidential, or proprietary information
The Company may rely on AI models developed by third-parties, and, to that extent, would be dependent in part on the manner in which those third parties develop and train their models
ai_positioning.summary: STEL adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques opérationnels, réglementaires et de conformité liés à l'implémentation de l'IA en interne, sans démontrer de capacités propriétaires ou de leadership technologique.
